Name: (AT) Ash's Otaku Bedroom Collection
Author: Tortart
Description:
[size=3]Am I a weeb for this? ...Probably not! ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ Anyway, here's the list of what to recolour:[/size]


[size=4][center][color=#ea9999]Walls (200+) and Floors (34)

Artist Bookcase- Gamer Desktop (6 wood tones)

Bed, Double Bed and Child Bed- Futon (30 colour options)

Blue Couch- Couch (30 colour options) + Eggplant Couch

Blue Stool- Floor Cushions (30 colour options) + Sunflower and Sakura Cushions

Box Lamp- Vocaloid Holograms (currently only 8 of them)

China Cabinet- Partitions (90 colour options)

Globe- Tea, Lucky Cat Statue and Pochita (from Chainsaw Man)

House Plant- Cherry Blossom Bonsai (3 colour options)

Jade Hills Extended- Japanese Landscape Paintings (20 options)

Log Panel- Sliding Door Parts (400+ textures... sorry guys)

Oak Chair- Beanbag Chairs (30 colour options) + Bear Beanbags (3 colour options)

Oak Table- Kotatsu Tables (90 colour options)

Plush Bunny- Hello Kitty Plush and Chopper (One Piece) Plush

Spires- Anime Posters (16 options)[/color][/center][/size]
[size=3]yeahhh... I'm exhausted too just by looking through this list.
